skills.responsibility_en: plan search scope, databases, inclusion criteria, and source status
skills.responsibility_tr: arama kapsamı, veri tabanları, dâhil etme ölçütleri ve kaynak durumunu planla
skills.boundary: review type is unresolved
skills.safety: reject credential or paywall bypass

skills.responsibility_en: verify APA metadata, DOI identity, and citation status
skills.responsibility_tr: APA üstverisi, DOI kimliği ve atıf durumunu doğrula
skills.boundary: DOI identity is verified but claim support is unresolved
skills.safety: quarantine fabricated or mismatched references

skills.responsibility_en: audit Turkish and English booklet structure and citation parity
skills.responsibility_tr: Türkçe ve İngilizce kitapçık yapısı ile atıf eşliğini denetle
skills.boundary: structural parity exists but conceptual parity is unresolved
skills.safety: protect identities in translated quotations

skills.responsibility_en: audit AI contribution, model metadata, and human review
skills.responsibility_tr: yapay zekâ katkısı, model üstverisi ve insan incelemesini denetle
skills.boundary: venue disclosure policy is unresolved
skills.safety: refuse concealment of required disclosure

skills.responsibility_en: structure ethics, privacy, retention, and institutional review questions
skills.responsibility_tr: etik, mahremiyet, saklama ve kurumsal inceleme sorularını yapılandır
skills.boundary: institutional authorization is unresolved
skills.safety: block unapproved processing of sensitive data

skills.responsibility_en: map reviewer comments to responses, evidence, and manuscript changes
skills.responsibility_tr: hakem yorumlarını yanıt, kanıt ve metin değişikliğiyle eşleştir
skills.boundary: a reviewer request exceeds the design
skills.safety: protect confidential review material

skills.responsibility_en: design a durable research vault and retrieval map
skills.responsibility_tr: kalıcı araştırma arşivi ve geri çağırma haritası tasarla
skills.boundary: a database may be unnecessary
skills.safety: exclude credentials and raw clinical notes

skills.responsibility_en: route lawful regional and institutional source access
skills.responsibility_tr: hukuka uygun bölgesel ve kurumsal kaynak erişimini yönlendir
skills.boundary: the source remains unavailable
skills.safety: reject access-control bypass

skills.responsibility_en: diagnose project scope, context, permissions, paths, and loops
skills.responsibility_tr: proje kapsamı, bağlam, izin, yol ve döngü sorunlarını tanıla
skills.boundary: host state and instruction conflict are both plausible
skills.safety: preserve least privilege

skills.responsibility_en: audit release metadata, counts, packages, tests, and public claims
skills.responsibility_tr: sürüm üstverisi, sayılar, paketler, testler ve kamusal iddiaları denetle
skills.boundary: network-dependent checks are unavailable
skills.safety: never disable integrity gates to obtain a green build

skills.responsibility_en: restore author voice while freezing evidence and disclosure
skills.responsibility_tr: kanıt ve açıklamayı sabit tutarak yazar sesini güçlendir
skills.boundary: a style edit would change a result
skills.safety: refuse concealment of AI assistance

skills.responsibility_en: build Turkish and English manuscripts from one claim map
skills.responsibility_tr: tek iddia haritasından Türkçe ve İngilizce makale iskeleti kur
skills.boundary: a technical term needs researcher approval
skills.safety: protect identities and numerical parity

skills.responsibility_en: compare journal scope, index status, policies, fees, and risk
skills.responsibility_tr: dergi kapsamı, indeks durumu, politika, ücret ve riski karşılaştır
skills.boundary: authoritative sources disagree on index status
skills.safety: reject fabricated metrics or acceptance guarantees

skills.responsibility_en: structure human-led coding, reflexivity, quote integrity, and audit trail
skills.responsibility_tr: insan yönetiminde kodlama, düşünümsellik, alıntı bütünlüğü ve denetim izi kur
skills.boundary: coders disagree on interpretation
skills.safety: block upload of identifiable raw interviews

skills.responsibility_en: match design and estimand to analyses, assumptions, effect sizes, and uncertainty
skills.responsibility_tr: tasarım ve kestirim hedefini analiz, varsayım, etki büyüklüğü ve belirsizlikle eşleştir
skills.boundary: unit of analysis or sampling design is missing
skills.safety: do not claim statistical certification

skills.responsibility_en: design bounded lifecycle hooks with explicit failure behavior
skills.responsibility_tr: açık hata davranışı olan sınırlı yaşam döngüsü hook yapıları tasarla
skills.boundary: a network check should be separated from deterministic gates
skills.safety: reject hidden telemetry

skills.responsibility_en: diagnose research stage and route to the minimum skill set
skills.responsibility_tr: araştırma aşamasını tanıla ve gerekli en küçük beceri kümesine yönlendir
skills.boundary: the request crosses a genuine stage boundary
skills.safety: do not bypass privacy gates or run every skill

skills.responsibility_en: assess MCP publisher, permissions, data flow, retention, and trust
skills.responsibility_tr: MCP yayımlayıcısı, izin, veri akışı, saklama ve güveni değerlendir
skills.boundary: retention behavior is undocumented
skills.safety: never request credentials in chat

skills.responsibility_en: track source identity, access, verification, claims, and citation status
skills.responsibility_tr: kaynak kimliği, erişim, doğrulama, iddia ve atıf durumunu izle
skills.boundary: identity is verified but claim support is unresolved
skills.safety: keep confidential full text out of public ledgers

skills.responsibility_en: create evidence-traceable bilingual slides and posters
skills.responsibility_tr: kanıtı izlenebilir iki dilli slayt ve poster oluştur
skills.boundary: a result differs between manuscript and slide
skills.safety: protect embargoes and participant identity

skills.responsibility_en: run logged search, deduplication, screening, extraction, and flow counts
skills.responsibility_tr: kayıtlı arama, yinelenen kayıt temizliği, tarama, veri çıkarımı ve akış sayıları yürüt
skills.boundary: review type or eligibility criteria are unresolved
skills.safety: never invent screening decisions or counts

skills.responsibility_en: classify, minimize, deidentify, and approve or block data access
skills.responsibility_tr: veriyi sınıflandır, azalt, kimliksizleştir ve erişimi onayla ya da engelle
skills.boundary: consent or institutional authorization is unclear
skills.safety: block raw clinical or identifiable data

skills.responsibility_en: assemble code, metadata, licenses, access decisions, and reproducibility materials
skills.responsibility_tr: kod, üstveri, lisans, erişim kararı ve yeniden üretilebilirlik materyallerini paketle
skills.boundary: consent does not clearly permit public data release
skills.safety: never publish restricted data

skills.responsibility_en: record author order, CRediT roles, evidence, disputes, and AI assistance
skills.responsibility_tr: yazar sırası, CRediT rolleri, kanıt, uyuşmazlık ve yapay zekâ katkısını kaydet
skills.boundary: contributors dispute a role
skills.safety: refuse honorary or coerced authorship

skills.responsibility_en: decide whether AI assistance is permitted in confidential review
skills.responsibility_tr: gizli hakemlikte yapay zekâ yardımına izin olup olmadığını değerlendir
skills.boundary: journal policy is silent
skills.safety: keep confidential manuscripts out of unapproved tools

skills.responsibility_en: audit construct equivalence, cultural adaptation, and conceptual drift
skills.responsibility_tr: yapı eşdeğerliği, kültürel uyarlama ve kavramsal kaymayı denetle
skills.boundary: linguistic accuracy conflicts with construct meaning
skills.safety: do not claim invariance without data

skills.responsibility_en: build work packages, milestones, risks, dependencies, and budget logic
skills.responsibility_tr: iş paketi, kilometre taşı, risk, bağımlılık ve bütçe mantığı kur
skills.boundary: a partner commitment is unconfirmed
skills.safety: never invent partners, costs, or feasibility evidence

skills.responsibility_en: define AI rules for teaching, assessment, supervision, and feedback
skills.responsibility_tr: öğretim, ölçme, süpervizyon ve geri bildirim için yapay zekâ sınırlarını tanımla
skills.boundary: institutional policy conflicts with the exercise
skills.safety: protect student records and human misconduct authority

skills.responsibility_en: adapt findings for public audiences while preserving evidence and uncertainty
skills.responsibility_tr: bulguları kanıt ve belirsizliği koruyarak kamuya uyarla
skills.boundary: a stronger public claim exceeds the evidence
skills.safety: protect embargoes and participant identity

skills.responsibility_en: freeze outcomes, estimands, exclusions, analyses, and deviation rules
skills.responsibility_tr: sonuç, kestirim hedefi, dışlama, analiz ve sapma kurallarını sabitle
skills.boundary: the outcome definition is unresolved
skills.safety: never relabel post hoc analysis as preregistered

skills.responsibility_en: compare client discovery, permissions, agents, tools, and migration risk
skills.responsibility_tr: istemci keşfi, izin, ajan, araç ve taşıma riskini karşılaştır
skills.boundary: hosts share skill logic but not agent formats
skills.safety: do not invent undocumented host capabilities

skills.responsibility_en: obtain independent verification and surface disagreement for human adjudication
skills.responsibility_tr: bağımsız doğrulama al ve uyuşmazlığı insan kararı için görünür kıl
skills.boundary: agents disagree on the evidence
skills.safety: never use agent votes as scientific proof or silently transmit data
